title: Childhood lights near the Gateway Arch

tellings.quote: And I would see lights going by and everything. I would see lights going by.

plain: Michael Johnson, a US Air Force veteran who says he was taken by alien beings, told podcast host Jesse Michels that as a child he would sit in O'Fallon Park in St. Louis, Missouri, near the Gateway Arch, the city's huge steel arch monument. He says he would often see lights going by in the sky there, which he tells as part of a lifelong pattern of strange experiences.
